The '''Rebel ship of the line''' was a model of [[Ship of the line/Legends|ship of the line]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Ship of the line/Legends|ship of the line]] was propelled through [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] by a set of eight [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]]. The [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] cargo hold was much bigger than on contemporary [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigates]].<ref name="Death Probe" /> Ships of the class were armed with multiple turreted weapons.<ref name="Dark Lord's Gambit">[[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]]</ref>

==History==
Along with smaller [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], several ships of the line participated in the strike on the Imperial task force said to be on its way to attack [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]]. They nearly fell into the trap planned by the [[House of Tagge/Legends|Tagge]] family, but were able to avoid the [[Omega Frost/Legends|Omega Frost]] weapon in the [[Feswe Corridor]].<ref name="Thunder in the Stars">[[Star Wars (1977) 34|''Star Wars'' (1977) 34]]</ref> The fleet then targeted the Tagge [[Mining Explorer]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge's]] [[General Tagge's battlecruiser|battlecruiser]].<ref name="Dark Lord's Gambit" />

A ship of the line later transported an [[Imperial warbot]] after the [[Battle of Xeron]]. Following an accident during its examination, the warbot was loaded onto [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Luke Skywalker's scout craft|scout craft]] and brought to [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]] for repairs.<ref name="Droid World" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Blockade_Runner_Sketchbook2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Blockade runner concept art.]]
The Rebel ship of the line is based on early concept art for the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']].
